institutional-knowledge.name: Institutional Knowledge Server
institutional-knowledge.description: Exposes git history, PR metadata, and team communication context as structured tools for OnboardOps cartography

tools.name: git_blame_summary
tools.description: Returns aggregated blame data for a file: top contributors, line ownership percentages, last modified dates

tools.name: commit_frequency
tools.description: Returns commit count per file over a time window (default: 180 days), sorted by frequency

tools.name: recent_authors
tools.description: Returns list of distinct authors who modified a file in the last N days, with commit counts

tools.name: pr_for_file
tools.description: Returns most recent pull request that modified a given file, with title, author, and merge date

tools.name: file_changelog
tools.description: Returns chronological list of commits affecting a file, with commit message, author, and date

tools.name: rationale_for_commit
tools.description: Returns commit message and PR description for a given commit SHA, explaining why the change was made

tools.name: incident_for_file
tools.description: Returns linked incidents or issues (from Linear, Jira, GitHub Issues) that mention the file

authentication.note: Server authenticates to GitHub via ONBOARDOPS_GITHUB_TOKEN env var; no auth required from Bob to server

caching.note: Server caches responses for 10 minutes to reduce GitHub API calls and Bobcoin spend
